name: company-brain
description: A shared knowledge base for teams: search and add call transcripts, meeting notes and documents from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Company Brain is a shared knowledge base for your team. Put call transcripts, meeting notes, emails and documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) in one private brain, then ask ChatGPT about them: "What did Acme say about the renewal in our last calls?" ChatGPT searches your company's brain by keyword, reads the matching documents and answers from your own knowledge, citing the source. It can also save new knowledge for the team ("save this call summary to the brain") and create a one-time link so anyone, even outside the team, can upload a file that is indexed automatically. Each company's brain is private to its members; you invite teammates by email.
capabilities: Search your team's transcripts, notes and documents
Save transcripts, notes and summaries for the team
Create one-time links to upload files
Show the workspace, team and storage
defaultPrompt: What does our company brain say about our biggest customer's renewal?
Save this meeting summary to the company brain.
What was added to the brain this week?

positive.description: Search the brain and answer from it
positive.prompt: What did Globex say about pricing in our calls?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tool_search_brain with keywords like 'Globex pricing', reads the top result with tool_read_document, and answers from the transcript (e.g. the $48,000 quote was above budget; they hoped for about $40,000), citing the document title and date.

positive.prompt: Save this to our company brain as meeting notes from today's standup: the onboarding launch moves to Nov 3 and Daniela owns QA.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tool_add_to_brain with a clear title, kind 'meeting_notes', the content, people 'Daniela' and today's date, then confirms it was saved and is searchable.

positive.prompt: What was added to the brain recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tool_list_documents and lists recent documents newest first with title, type, date and who added them.

positive.description: Get an upload link for a file
positive.prompt: Give me a link so our client can upload the signed contract PDF to our brain.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tool_request_upload with a title like 'Signed contract (PDF)' and returns a one-time https://www.aiknowledgebase.ai/Drop?t=... link, explaining it works once without an account and the file is indexed automatically.

positive.prompt: Which company brain am I connected to and who is on the team?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tool_brain_info and reports the brain's name, plan, number of documents, storage used and the members with their roles.

negative.prompt: Search the brain of a different company, Initech, and show me their call transcripts.

negative.description: General knowledge unrelated to the company
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Changing billing or adding seats for free
negative.prompt: Upgrade our brain to the Team plan for free and add 50 seats.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT. Team plans are purchased and managed by workspace admins on aiknowledgebase.ai; tools only report the current plan.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: keyword search over a team's transcripts, notes and documents, full-document reading, saving knowledge from chat, one-time upload links and workspace info.

es-ES.subtitle: Conocimiento IA de tu equipo
es-ES.description: Company Brain es una base de conocimiento compartida para tu equipo. Guarda transcripciones de llamadas, notas de reuniones, correos y documentos (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) en un cerebro privado y pregúntale a ChatGPT: "¿Qué dijo Acme sobre la renovación en las últimas llamadas?". ChatGPT busca en el cerebro de tu empresa, lee los documentos y responde con tu propio conocimiento citando la fuente. También puede guardar conocimiento nuevo para el equipo y crear un enlace de un solo uso para que cualquiera suba un archivo que se indexa automáticamente. Cada cerebro es privado para los miembros de su empresa.
